title: Shards of the Beyond

{{Location Infobox |image = Lost Beyond.png |type = Point of Interest |type2 = Instance |icon = Lost Beyond Map Marker.png |nation = Rinascita |region = Fabricatorium of the Deep }} {{Quote|The Beyond—that promised perfection—is no more in this world, at least for now. Yet deep beneath the sea, its broken fragments still glimmer with echoes of old obsession and hope. Whenever you return, you'll hear joyful laughter of rebirth, as if this land still holds the promise of eternity.}} The '''Lost Beyond''' is a [[Point of Interest]] located in {{Location|Fabricatorium of the Deep|nocat=1}} and a [[Sonoro Sphere]] created by [[Phrolova]]. == Glossary == {{Description|Phrolova's Sonoro Sphere, designed to replicate the Beyond through artificial means. Using the powers of Threnodian Leviathan, she intends to use bodies of Tacet Discords as hosts for the reverberating consciousness of the departed. In doing so, the Sonoro may merge with reality, and those long past can live in a new, eternal world free of decay.|Glossary Excerpt}} == Overview == The Lost Beyond is an artificially created Sonoro Sphere made by Phrolova as a means to make a land of serenity, harmony, and perfection. Her goal was to create a world that is unaffected by the reach of time nor tragedy, which contains the Frequencies of those she lost and desires the Sonoro Sphere to become a reality. She chose this method as her research found that while Artificial Sonoro Spheres have a short duration with inherit instability, followed by how the influence of Fortes can cause unintended changes to them alongside needing constant sustained applications of her Resonance ability, it was considered a solid support for her needs in transferring the frequencies of her loved ones into it. However, due to it's nature, Phrolova is unable to make it whole and thus needed a divine "texture" to stabilize it: [[Leviathan|Leviathan's Gem]], which contained the essence and power of the Threnodian itself. Without it, the Lost Beyond was unstable, which Phrolova could tell as she was linked with her artificial creation itself. Any disharmony felt in the realm notified her in an instant, primarily due to it being tied to her life. Although, a consequence was that '''t'''he Lost Beyond began merging with her, with the [[Schwarzloch|Grand Architect]] suggesting that as it holds onto her tighter, her life was at risk. At the same time, she can recover so long as she's in sync with the merging between her and the Lost Beyond. Though, she was unable to claim the gem,which would allow "perfect harmony", due to [[Fenrico|Fenrico's]] and [[Rover|Rover's]] interference. More than that, while she was able to sustain the Lost Beyond for a time after her physical form temporarily perished and had her frequencies merge with it, [[Cristoforo]] commented that even with Leviathan's power, the Sonoro Sphere couldn't endure. It's unclear if the Lost Beyond has collapsed at present or if the experiment itself simply failed. == Residents == The residents found in the Lost Beyond are all people who Phrolova knew and lived with from their original home of [[Ostina]]. After their demise, Phrolova captured their frequencies and stored them in her right eye, with her plans being to resurrect them as immortal beings with the Lost Beyond being created as a sanctuary and new home for them. However, Phrolova's ideal form for them was that from her research and her own existence as a Tacet Discord/Human hybrid, believed they to should become like her, supported by the Grand Architect as her earlier attempts in her long life failed until he appeared. However, the residents frequencies were slowly fading, with much of Phrolova's focus being to find a method in preserving their human consciousness. Thus she sought Leviathan's power of Unity to grant them a proper "rebirth", as while she could merge Reverberations with Tacet Discords on her own, Leviathan's powers of assimilation were greater than her own capabilities.. At present, she had successfully merged their Reverberations with Tacet Discords, keeping their consciousness alive but intends to creating new vessels for them through Leviathan's Gem so they'd be properly revived. At a first glance, everyone in the Lost Beyond appears indistinguishable from real people. Even so, her attempts in doing this made it so that they could never truly be human again, as at times the Lost Beyond's residents will transform into Tacet Discords without anyone realizing it, which the Rover considered insane. As the Rover proclaims, those fading Reverberations cannot return to life, no matter how long she holds onto their frequencies, where all she created were unusual Tacet Discords. This, alongside their imprisonment in Phrolova's eye, has caused the residents to go half-mad as beyond a few like Triss, some find their existence unbearable and desire death but eventually switch back to seeking immortal life. It's suggested Phrolova keeps the Lost Beyond in a loop of sorts while manipulating their memories in an attempt to keep them from fully succumbing to insanity. ==NPCs== * [[Aeschylus]] * [[Caleres]] * [[Searle|Denali]] * [[Ynkwell|Grace]] * [[Leah]] * [[Luneau]] * [[Melissa]] * [[Lunaeu|Noemie]] * [[Phrolova]] * [[Pier]] * [[Searle|Samp]] * [[Searle]] * [[Triss]] * [[Ynkwell]] ==Notable Interactions== {{Dialogue Start}} ;(Appears after completing {{Quest|Dreamcatchers in the Secret Gardens}}. Located within Phrolova home.) :{{Description|I want to learn so many instruments. I want to understand every musical sound.

Ms. Searle told me that many conductors are well-practicied in a range of instruments. I want to be like that too.

If I could make an orchestra reproduce the perfect melody in my mind, surely that would be my greatest joy.

Will that day ever come when I can precisely identify and control the sound of each instrument to transform every note into a passionate cry?

Ms. Searle also said there are times when I should give up the urge for control and give the orchestra space to breathe and create.

But if I do that, how will I be sure that the music at my command is flawless?}} ---- :{{Description|{{MC|m=He|f=She}} never appeared again.
I have already found a path of my own. This new path is the right one on which I shall complete the symphony of life and death.
I no longer need friends. All I need is a sharpened sword.}} {{Dialogue End}} ==Soundtracks== {{Soundtracks by Category Table|type=location}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = Shards of the Beyond |1_zhs = 彼岸之镜 |1_zht = 彼岸之鏡 |1_ja = 冥府の鏡 |1_ko = 피안의 거울 |1_es = Fragmentos del Más Allá |1_fr = Éclats de l’Au-delà |1_de = Splitter des Jenseits |2_en = The Lost Beyond |2_zhs = 失亡彼岸 |2_zht = 失亡彼岸 |2_ja = 喪失の冥府 |2_ko = 죽음의 피안 |2_es = Más Allá Perdido |2_fr = L'Au-delà perdu |2_de = Das Verlorene Jenseits }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.5}} ==References== {{Reflist}} ==Navigation== {{PoI Navbox|Rinascita}}
